title: shared expert basis plus Mirror coefficient
hypothesis: Eight routed expert functions generated as unit-circle coefficients over two shared physical expert matrices can be represented by two matrices plus one Mirror angle per role; this should compress versus full MoE, while independent matrices should need more basis rank. Generic learned two-coefficient shared-basis control may match Mirror and bounds any Mirror-specific claim.
mirror_coordinate: one angle per logical expert, decoded as (cos(phi), sin(phi))
logical_multiplicity: eight hard-routed expert functions composed from the two physical bases

task.routing: deterministic three-sign role id, supplied identically to all methods

teacher_modes.unit_circle_basis: each expert is a unit-circle linear combination of two random shared matrices

task.structure_audit: maximum per-role MSE across eight roles

controls: shared expert plus rank-1 per-role residual
generic shared rank-2 basis with two learned coefficients per role
shared rank-2 basis with one learned Mirror angle per role

development.selection_metric: mean held-out MSE pooled across methods and both teacher modes

training.router: oracle hard route; routing quality not tested

storage.authority: actual serialized full inference payload bytes
storage.serialization: torch.save state_dict plus deterministic config JSON
paid_objects: full expert matrices or shared bases
per-role Mirror angles or generic coefficients

success_gate: In all three fresh unit-circle worlds, Mirror MSE <=1.10x full MoE MSE and payload <=0.40x full MoE, while beating the generic shared-rank-2 control by >=10% in payload at no more than 5% worse MSE. Independent mode is a boundary test.
failure_gate: Mirror misses full-MoE quality/storage gates in two or more fresh worlds, or generic rank-2 control matches Mirror quality with equal/lower payload and compute. Independent-mode failure alone is a structural boundary.
boundaries: teacher is aligned to two-basis unit-circle coefficients
hard route supplied; no router claim
fixed update screen, not language or capacity claim
